correctness.rationale: Replayed inputs/artifacts/verify.py -> VERIFY_OK; independently re-checked with separate frozenset/pair logic: W1 and W2 each have 33 triples on 0..15, 99 distinct covered pairs (3 per triple, no repeat) so valid packings. Exhaustive C(33,5)=237336 search gives 0 five-disjoint-tuple in each (PPC<=4); C(33,4)=40920 enumeration gives 269 (W1) and 266 (W2) disjoint 4-sets, so PPC==4 exactly. Degree multisets differ (W1 min 5: [5x4,6x5,7x7]; W2 has a 4: [4,5x2,6x6,7x7]), an isomorphism invariant, so pair is non-isomorphic. Ceiling recomputed analytically: per-point degree <=floor(15/2)=7, 3B<=112 so B<=37. Definitions consistent: witnesses have max PPC exactly 4, so lower bound holds under either 'exactly rho' (Stinson) or 'at most rho' reading; upper bound is universal. Draft honestly states interval only, no UNSAT above 33 claimed.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Stinson arXiv:2007.11033 full-text HTML verified -- defines beta(rho,v), proves Thm 2.4 lower bound (for (4,16): rho(v-rho)/2+D(rho)=24+1=25) and Thm 3.2 counting upper bound (trivial <=37 at v=16 since v<3rho+12), Theta(v) vs Theta(v^2) with rho-dependent constant gap, exact beta(1,v) and intervals for beta(2,3,v), Table 1 only for v=27, Sec 6 open tightening -- no beta(4,16) witness or value >=26. Demirkale et al. arXiv:1708.07646 abstract/full metadata verified: 47,744,568 MMPTS(16) maximum 37-triple systems with automorphism/Pasch/mitre/Fano tables only, no parallel-class/resolution/PPC/beta column, so orthogonal to full-class-free sub-maximum number. Bryant-Horsley arXiv:1407.5766 constructs no-parallel-class STS for orders 3 mod 6 (full STS, different objects from even-order packings with 9-pair leave), motivates but does not imply beta(4,16). Alspach-Kreher-Pastine sequencing work consumes beta bounds but states no beta(4,16). The 33-triple PPC==4 witnesses raising floor 25->33 are not recorded or mechanically implied.

value.rationale: Strongest headline judged separately: exact existential fact of 33-triple full-class-free packings (PPC exactly 4) on 16 points, with two non-isomorphic witnesses, raising Stinson constructive floor 25->33 (+8 blocks, ~32%) at the natural full-class threshold rho=4,v=16 (5 disjoint triples = full class up to one point; smallest even order where boundary nontrivial). Object and invariant were motivated before computation by two pre-existing programs (Bryant-Horsley no-parallel-class avoidance; Stinson beta(rho,v) theory with sequenceable-PSTS downstream use); value 33 was not known or mechanically implied by Theta bounds; future beta/sequenceability researcher could reasonably need the precise witness/interval. Honestly described as interval [33,37] with 34-37 open -- incompleteness does not erase the exact witness headline. Not a textbook restatement (upper 37 is standard Schoenheim framing only), not mere parameter substitution, not tiny gain, not unexplained arbitrary number. Fits eligible narrow exact-invariant datum.
